caption: Can’t live with a baddie can’t live without one
author: VB
transcript: The minute the plane landed in Mexico City, I got an email from my ex and it said something like I understand now that your refusal to settle was never simply ambition. It was something much deeper. A radical loyalty to yourself and almost visceral refusal to betray yourself. A living a life that did not feel like yours. I am capable of feeling joy as I watch you run even though it hurts to know that this time you're running towards a place where I am not. To run Vic will change lives, you change mine.
title: Heartfelt Message from an Ex on Arrival
one_liner: A moving email from an ex reflects on self-loyalty and personal growth during a trip to Mexico City.
key_points: Ex acknowledges her 'radical loyalty to herself' as deeper than ambition
Recognizes her refusal to live a life that didn't feel authentic
Expresses bittersweet joy watching her move toward a future without him
Closes with 'you will change lives, you changed mine'
